messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] service: embeddings-api eu-west-1 - elevated 5xx rate (>8% p95) detected. Auto-rollbacks disabled for dedicated pools. Paging on-call.
mike_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. @sara_ops can you pull the customer list for dedicated tenants in eu-west-1? Need account impact ASAP.
sara_ops: Pulling now. Running query against account routing table, will paste CSV subset in a sec.
sara_ops: (paste)
```
account,customer_tier,primary_contact,secondary_contact,escalation_phone,notes
cardinal-analytics,enterprise,ops+cardinal@cust.com,eng+cardinal@cust.com,+44 7700 900111,uses-dedicated-eu-west
stratuspay-enterprise,enterprise,alerts@stratuspay.com,infra@stratuspay.com,+44 7700 900222,high-traffic-embeds
blue-marline,enterprise,cs@bluemarline.com,ops@bluemarline.com,+44 7700 900333,has-onprem-fallback
hightower-bio,midmarket,contact@hightower.bio,eng@hightower.bio,+44 7700 900444,monitoring-alerts-on
```
mike_oncall: Thanks. Initial impact: errors correlate with KV cache exhaustion on driver nodes for dedicated pools. Mitigation in progress: temporary scale-up + restart of affected workers.
emma_comm: Drafting customer-facing blurb for impacted enterprise accounts. Please confirm impact lines I should include.
linda_custsuccess: For Cardinal and StratusPay we need tailored impact: Cardinal has real-time scoring pipelines; StratusPay runs nightly settling. Blue-Marline has fallback but needs heads-up.
emma_comm: Draft 1 for Cardinal:
"Dear Cardinal Analytics team — between 15:02–15:20 UTC we observed elevated errors for Redwood embeddings in eu-west-1 which may have caused failed scoring requests. Our engineers performed an automated scale-up and are verifying data integrity. We will follow up with a full timeline and any remediation steps within 3 hours."
raj_product: Add note: "No customer data was exfiltrated or modified. Only transient request failures and increased latencies." Legal ok?
linda_custsuccess: Legal okay on that phrasing. Also include recommended retry guidance: exponential backoff 500→1s, 1.5x, max 8s and idempotency best practices for batched scoring.
emma_comm: Good. Status page snippet: "We are investigating increased error rates for the embeddings API in eu-west-1 affecting dedicated customers. Engineers are performing mitigations and verifying recovery."
mike_oncall: Mitigation update: scaled dedicated pool + rotated 2 driver nodes at 15:08 UTC — 5xx rate down to ~1.8% at 15:14 UTC. Continuing validation of KV caches and tail latencies. If stable for next 10m we'll mark as mitigated.
jordan_sre: Noted. I'll run a sweep for cache thrash patterns and add a temporary quota for continuous-batch jobs to prevent recurrence this window.
sara_ops: Routing note for paging/escalation: if any account reports business impact escalate to oncall manager @raj_product -> +1 to exec on-call after 30m unresolved.
mike_oncall: Customer messages queued for review: Cardinal, StratusPay, Blue-Marline. @linda_custsuccess please send Cardinal and Stratus now; Stratus once we confirm settlement window not affected.
linda_custsuccess: Sending Cardinal now. Pasted message to Cardinal Ops channel and email thread.
emma_comm: Sending Stratus template to the Slack thread for approval before send:
```
To: alerts@stratuspay.com
Subject: Redwood incident: embeddings API (eu-west-1) — potential request failures
Body: Hi StratusPay team,
We observed elevated error rates affecting Redwood embeddings in eu-west-1 between 15:02–15:20 UTC. Our team scaled capacity and rotated affected workers; we're monitoring and will confirm if your nightly settlement window is impacted within 60 minutes. Contact: cs+stratus@redwood.com
```
raj_product: Approved. Also prepare a short postmortem action: add proactive cache-size guard + autoscale threshold bump for dedicated pools.
mike_oncall: Status: last 5m stable at 0.9% 5xx. Keeping thread open for 30m then degrade to monitoring. If any customer reports degraded service, re-open.
incident-bot: Reaction recorded: :white_check_mark: mitigation-step-1-complete
jordan_sre: I'll pick this up for the night handoff. @mike_oncall please add a short runbook note with the exact restart command you used.
mike_oncall: Runbook note:
```
# rotate-driver
kubectl -n redwood rotate driver --pool dedicated-eu-west --driver-id driver-3
sleep 30
check logs: kubectl logs -f driver-3 -c inference
```
mike_oncall: Handing off to @jordan_sre for overnight watch. Leaving monitoring alerts tuned to 1% 5xx.
jordan_sre: Taking over. I'll follow up with a brief executive note if any regression occurs. Closing customer notifications loop.
linda_custsuccess: Confirmed Cardinal acknowledged. Blue-Marline sent a heads-up (they will use on-prem fallback for 20m). All good from CS side.
emma_comm: Preparing final status page update: "Mitigated — embedded API error rates returned to baseline after autoscale and worker rotation. Dedicated pool drivers rotated; engineers are validating cache integrity. No evidence of data loss. Full incident timeline forthcoming."
mike_oncall: Marking thread as monitoring. last check at 15:49 UTC — system stable.
note: This thread contains sensitive customer routing info; restrict export per policy.
